title: CLASSIFIER-TO-BIAS: Toward Unsupervised Automatic Bias Detection for Visual Classifiers
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of detecting visual biases (such as gender, age, lighting, or shape) in computer vision classifiers like ResNet and ViT. While it utilizes Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate bias hypotheses and contains a standard section on 'Ethical statement and broader impact', it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks.
